```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(proxy)
library(cluster)  
library(factoextra)
library(ggpubr)

options(warn = -1)
library(here)
library(purrr)
library(furrr)
library(progressr)
library(kableExtra)
library(plotly)
library(ggridges)
options(warn = 0)

pop <- params$pop
csv_path_abs <- normalizePath(
  file.path("../reference/output", sprintf("ref_%s.csv", pop)),
  mustWork = TRUE
)

```



```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=9, fig.height=11, out.width="100%"}

source(here("scripts/haplogroup_processing_dataframe.R"))
compute_path <- here("scripts", "haplogroup_processing_dataframe.R")



phylotreeVersion <- "17_FU1"
combined_df<-read.delim("array_illumina/combined_arrays.txt")

final_representatives <-read.delim("array_illumina/final_representative_arrays.txt", sep=",")
unique_cluster_df <-read.delim("array_illumina/all_unique_arrays.txt", sep=",")

.options = furrr_options(
  globals = c("process_haplogroup_data", "hsd_path_abs"),
  packages = c("dplyr", "stringr", "networkD3", "htmlwidgets")
)

#args(process_haplogroup_data)
#readLines("../scripts/haplogroup_processing.R", n = 100)

##test-scenarios######################################################
#hsd_path_abs <- normalizePath("data/test10AFR.hsd", mustWork = TRUE)
#hsd_path_abs <- normalizePath("data/test193AFR.hsd", mustWork = TRUE)
#hsd_data <- read.delim(hsd_path_abs)
#hsd_data[[3]] <- ""
#hsd_data <- hsd_data[, colSums(is.na(hsd_data)) == 0]


csv_data <- read.delim(csv_path_abs, sep=",")
hsd_data <- csv_data[,1:4]
hsd_data$SampleID<-paste(hsd_data$SampleID,"-",hsd_data$Haplogroup, sep="")
hsd_data[[3]] <- ""
hsd_data <- hsd_data[, colSums(is.na(hsd_data)) == 0]
hsd_data <- hsd_data[hsd_data$SampleID != "mt-MRCA", ]


#plan(sequential)
#closeAllConnections()

groups <- split(combined_df, combined_df$Microarray_ID)

# Filter based on clustering analysis
#rep_names_full <- trimws(str_remove(final_representatives$ArrayType, "\\s*\\(.*"))
#test_groups <- groups[names(groups) %in% rep_names_full]

#Filter based on unique arrays - basically run over all
rep_names_unique <- trimws(str_remove(unique_cluster_df$ArrayType,  "\\s*\\(.*"))
test_groups <- groups[names(groups) %in% rep_names_unique]


plan(multisession, workers = parallel::detectCores() - 2)

handlers("progress")

with_progress({
  haplogroupsDiff_all <- future_map_dfr(
    test_groups,
    function(df_group) {
      current_id <- unique(df_group$Microarray_ID)
      process_haplogroup_data(
        array_type = current_id,
        array_df = df_group,
        hsd_data = hsd_data,
        pop=pop,
        output_base_name = paste0("out_", current_id)
      )
    },
    .options = furrr_options(
      globals = c(
        "process_haplogroup_data",
        "hsd_data",
        "pop",
        "phylotreeVersion",
        "get_Supergroups",
        ".derive_MacroPhylo"
      ),
      packages = c("dplyr", "stringr", "networkD3", "htmlwidgets", "here")
    ),
    .progress = TRUE
  )
})

p <- ggplot(haplogroupsDiff_all, aes(x = distance, color = ArrayType, group = ArrayType)) +
  stat_ecdf(geom = "line") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(p)


ggplot(haplogroupsDiff_all, aes(x = distance, y = ArrayType, fill = ..x..)) +
  geom_density_ridges_gradient(scale = 3, rel_min_height = 0.01) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Distance", option = "C") +
  labs(title = "Distributions of Distances across Genotyping Arrays") +
  theme_ridges() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6)) # Shrink text to fit 150 labels


ggplot(haplogroupsDiff_all, aes(x = distance, group = ArrayType)) +
  # Draw all 150 lines in very light gray
  stat_ecdf(geom = "line", color = "gray90", size = 0.2) + 
  # Highlight the global average or a specific group of interest in bold
  stat_ecdf(data = haplogroupsDiff_all, aes(x = distance, group = 1), 
            geom = "line", color = "deepskyblue1", linewidth = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Individual Haplogroup Distance vs. Global Average (Blue)")


# 1. Calculate percentiles for each ArrayType
# We'll look at every 10th percentile plus the 95th and 99th for outlier detection
heatmap_data <- haplogroupsDiff_all %>%
  group_by(ArrayType) %>%
  reframe(
    percentile = c(seq(0.1, 0.9, by = 0.1), 0.95, 0.99),
    dist_value = quantile(distance, probs = percentile, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# 2. Create the Heatmap
ggplot(heatmap_data, aes(x = factor(percentile), 
                         y = reorder(ArrayType, dist_value, FUN = median), 
                         fill = dist_value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  # Using the 'magma' palette which is great for seeing density/intensity
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", name = "Observed\nDistance") +
  labs(
    title = "Haplogroup Distance Fingerprints",
    subtitle = "Groups sorted by median distance",
    x = "Percentile (0.5 = Median)",
    y = "Array Type (n=150)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    # With 150 rows, the Y-axis text must be very small
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5), 
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )


# Calculate means and grab top 20
top_20 <- haplogroupsDiff_all %>%
  group_by(ArrayType) %>%
  summarize(mean_dist = mean(distance, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  slice_max(mean_dist, n = 20)

# Plot with reorder() to break alphabetical sorting
ggplot(top_20, aes(x = mean_dist, y = reorder(ArrayType, mean_dist))) +
  geom_col(fill = "firebrick") +
  labs(
    title = "Worst 20 Array Types by Highest Mean Distance",
    x = "Mean Observed Distance (lower=better)",
    y = "Array Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


# Calculate means and grab bottom 20
bottom_20 <- haplogroupsDiff_all %>%
  group_by(ArrayType) %>%
  summarize(mean_dist = mean(distance, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  slice_min(mean_dist, n = 20)

# Plot with reorder() - negative mean_dist sorts it from lowest to highest
ggplot(bottom_20, aes(x = mean_dist, y = reorder(ArrayType, -mean_dist))) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Best 20 Array Types by Lowest Mean Distance",
    x = "Mean Observed Distance (lower = better)",
    y = "Array Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


#######################################

# 1. Rank your ArrayTypes by performance (e.g., Median distance)
ranking <- haplogroupsDiff_all %>%
  group_by(ArrayType) %>%
  summarize(med = median(distance, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(med)

top_5 <- head(ranking$ArrayType, 5)
bottom_5 <- tail(ranking$ArrayType, 5)
keep_in_legend <- c(top_5, bottom_5)

# 2. Add a 'ShowInLegend' flag and 'CustomColor' to your data
haplogroupsDiff_all <- haplogroupsDiff_all %>%
  mutate(
    Group = ifelse(ArrayType %in% keep_in_legend, as.character(ArrayType), "Other"),
    InLegend = ArrayType %in% keep_in_legend
  )

# 3. Build the Plot
p <- ggplot(haplogroupsDiff_all, aes(x = distance, color = Group, group = ArrayType)) +
  # Use 'text' aesthetic to customize the mouse-over tooltip
  stat_ecdf(geom = "line", aes(text = paste("Array:", ArrayType)), lwd = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    setNames(scales::hue_pal()(length(keep_in_legend)), keep_in_legend), 
    "Other" = "grey85"
  )) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:25) +
  labs(title = "Interactive Haplogroup Distribution", x = "Distance", y = "Cumulative Prop") +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# 4. Convert to Plotly and fix the legend
# We hide the legend for 'Other' items to keep it clean
fig <- ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") %>%
  style(showlegend = FALSE, traces = which(unique(haplogroupsDiff_all$Group) == "Other"))

fig

######################################
### LIMIT THE ARRAYS to 10 Clusters 

# Join back to your main distance data

final_representatives <- final_representatives %>%
  mutate(ArrayType = clean_text <- sub("\\s*\\(.*", "", ArrayType)) 


rep_20_plot_data <- haplogroupsDiff_all %>%
  filter(ArrayType %in% final_representatives$ArrayType) %>%
  left_join(final_representatives, by = "ArrayType")

ggplot(rep_20_plot_data, aes(x = distance, color = extreme_label, group = ArrayType)) +
  stat_ecdf(geom = "line", size = 1.1) +
  facet_wrap(~ClusterID, ncol = 5, labeller = label_both) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Highest" = "#D55E00", "Lowest" = "#0072B2", "Mean-ish"="#009E73")) +
  labs(
    title = "Comparison of Cluster Extremes",
    subtitle = "Comparing arrays with the largest vs. smallest bracketed ID within each cluster",
    x = "Observed Haplogroup Distance",
    y = "Cumulative Proportion",
    color = "Intra-Cluster Rank"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA),
        legend.position = "bottom")

#######################################



max_dist <- max(haplogroupsDiff_all$distance)
dist_range <- 0:max_dist
num_points <- length(dist_range)

auc_results <- haplogroupsDiff_all %>%
  group_by(ArrayType) %>%
  summarise(
    AUC_Normalized = sum(ecdf(distance)(dist_range)) / num_points,
    Mean_Distance = mean(distance, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  ) %>%
  mutate(Tier = case_when(
    AUC_Normalized >= 0.95 ~ "🥇 Gold (Excellent)",
    AUC_Normalized >= 0.85 ~ "🥈 Silver (Good)",
    AUC_Normalized >= 0.75 ~ "🥉 Bronze (Fair)",
    TRUE                   ~ "⚠️ Low Performance"
  )) %>%
  arrange(desc(AUC_Normalized))

# Update names for the Sankey section
best_array_name  <- auc_results$ArrayType[1]
worst_array_name <- auc_results$ArrayType[nrow(auc_results)]


auc_results$Population<-pop

write.table(auc_results, file=paste("AUC_results_",pop,".txt", sep=""), sep=",",row.names = FALSE)

kable(auc_results, 
      col.names = c("Microarray", "Normalized AUC", "Mean Distance", "Sample Size", "Performance Tier", "Population"),
      digits = 3,
      caption = paste("Microarray Performance Ranking with Tiers", pop))

ggplot(auc_results, aes(x = reorder(ArrayType, AUC_Normalized), y = AUC_Normalized, fill = Tier)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("🥇 Gold (Excellent)" = "#FFD700", 
                               "🥈 Silver (Good)" = "#C0C0C0", 
                               "🥉 Bronze (Fair)" = "#CD7F32", 
                               "⚠️ Low Performance" = "#E57373")) +
  labs(title = paste("Microarray Accuracy Scores (AUC Norm.) ", pop),
       x = "Microarray Type",
       y = "Accuracy Score (0-1)",
       fill = "Tier") +
  theme_minimal()
